118382.name: Chabad of Bethesda
118382.note: Washington Jewish Week, 22 June 2023: 'Chabad of Bethesda was established in a commercial property in 1999'; Rabbi Bentzion and Zlata Geisinsky founded it (their son Rabbi Sender Geisinsky leads it now). A 2010 tribute to Zlata Geisinsky (zlatasimpact.blogspot.com): 'The pair moved to Bethesda nearly 11 years ago'. Medium: Washington Jewish Week on CrownHeights.info, 28 Nov 2012, says 'In 2000, they left their work at the Chabad center in Potomac, to found Chabad of Bethesda-Chevy Chase': a year apart.

118581.name: Chabad of Owings Mills
118581.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 Sept 2011: Chabad of Owings Mills was 'Founded in 2003, it didn't start programming until 2005 with the arrival of Katsenelenbogen, his wife, Chanie'; 'In 2005, the year he arrived, Katsenelenbogen started a weekly worship service'. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (July 2004). Medium: one source.

118207.name: Chabad Lubavitch Center of Eastern Shore
118207.note: The Jewish Link, 2 June 2016: 'Rabbi Cohen and his wife, Cohava, have been directing the center there for 20 years.' Del Marva Now on CrownHeights.info, 22 July 2011: Rabbi Noam Cohen of the Ocean City-based Chabad Lubavitch Center, 'an Ocean City resident for 15 years'. Medium: both counted back (about 1996).

704078.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Towson
704078.note: Baltimore Jewish Times on CrownHeights.info, 20 Nov 2008 ('Chabad's Towson Debut'): 'Last July, Rabbi Mendy and Sheiny Rivkin took posts as the new Chabad shluchim, or emissaries, at Towson University'; Rivkin had to 'start from scratch'. Its chabad.org listing went up 20 July 2008.

768404.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Frederick
768404.note: The Frederick News-Post, reprinted 30 Oct 2008 ('Chabad to establish presence in Frederick'): 'Boruch Labkowski, a New York-based rabbi, has started a local chapter of Chabad in Frederick and is also the group's director.' Medium: the Frederick News-Post on CrownHeights.info (2011) says 'Labkowski formed Chabad of Frederick in 2009', and its chabad.org listing went up 25 Aug 2009: a year apart.

1327970.name: Chabad of Clarksville
1327970.note: Jewish Telegraph profile (about 2012): Leeds-born Rabbi Yosef Chaim Sufrin 'is making a massive impact since establishing a Chabad House there two years ago' in Clarksville. Its chabad.org listing went up 15 Oct 2010. Medium: counted back, and the profile's exact date isn't shown.

3043157.name: Chabad of Chevy Chase
3043157.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 Feb 2015 ('New Shluchim to Maryland'): 'Rabbi Shneur Zalman and Mushka Minkowitz will be moving on Shlichus to the Chevy Chase area of Maryland', appointed by Rabbi Bentzion Geisinsky of Merkaz Menachem Chabad; 'will be moving to their new post shortly'. Its chabad.org listing went up 26 Aug 2015.

6447578.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Bowie Maryland
6447578.note: CrownHeights.info, 7 Apr 2024 ('New Shluchim To The City of Bowie, MD'): Rabbi Eli and Chaya Mushka Baron 'will shortly assume a new Shlichus position'; 'the Barons will open the first permanent Chabad Center in the city of Bowie.' Its chabad.org listing went up 2 July 2024.

6518301.name: Chabad of Glen Burnie and Pasadena
6518301.note: Chabad.org on CrownHeights.info, 17 Aug 2024 (Miriam Mintz, 30): with her husband Rabbi Mendel Mintz 'she was preparing to relocate to Baltimore's southern suburbs, where they were starting a Chabad Center to serve Pasadena and Glen Burnie'; 'A little more than a month ago ... they finalized the plans for their new Chabad center'. Its chabad.org listing went up 5 Aug 2024.

7269663.name: Chabad of Kent Island
7269663.note: CrownHeights.info, 20 May 2026 ('New Shluchim to Historic Kent Island'): 'Rabbi Mendel and Rivky Stern ... are establishing a new Shlichus based in Kent Island, serving the entire Upper Eastern Shore of Maryland'. Its chabad.org listing went up 13 Apr 2026.

4578619.name: Chabad of Ellicott City
4578619.note: Lubavitch.com, 16 June 2020 ('New Shluchim to Ellicott City'): 'Rabbi Yanky and Leah Baron will join the team at Chabad of Columbia, Maryland, establishing a new Chabad community in Ellicott City'. Its chabad.org listing went up 7 Jan 2020.

118536.name: Chabad Israeli Center of Rockville
118536.note: Washington Jewish Week, 2 Sept 2025: 'The Chabad Israeli Center of Rockville saw its start in 2002, when Beitsh and his wife moved from Brooklyn to Rockville.' Medium: one source so far (a Times of Israel blog is said to give summer 2002; not read).

4262951.name: Chabad of Catonsville & UMBC
4262951.note: WMAR-2 News, 15 Dec 2025: Rabbi Dovid Reyder 'arrived in 2019 to serve Jewish students and the Catonsville community, which he said lacked an official Jewish presence before the congregation began its work.' Its chabad.org listing went up 17 Jan 2019.

5694978.name: Mesivta Lubavitch Baltimore
5694978.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 Feb 2022 ('New Baltimore Mesivta For 5783 Shnas Halimudim'): 'A new Mesivta in Balitmore will open IY"H' for the 5783 school year (from Sept 2022), with Rabbi Mendel Kaminker as interim menahel. Its chabad.org listing went up 8 Nov 2022.

547217.name: Chabad of Downtown
547217.note: Baltimore Jewish Living on COLlive (read through Firecrawl), 8 Dec 2020: Chabad of Downtown Baltimore (Rabbi Levi and Chani Druk) 'marked its 13th anniversary' ('Chabad of Baltimore's bar mitzvah anniversary'); its chabad.org listing went up 15 Oct 2007. Medium: the same article also says 'Founded in 2008': a year apart.
